text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Gah-choooon!
I... lost...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Will the 'Bakushin' be gone,
and you'll just become 'Sakura O'?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But, but...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ――This is completely unexpected!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To think there's someone out there
who can beat ME in speed!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Flower-san... I knew you were fast, but to think you were THAT fast!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Guhhhh~~~~!
At this rate, my position as Class Rep will be snatched away!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I don't want to step down as class rep~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
True!
The faster you are, the more respected you are!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And I am capable of doing so...!
For I am speed incarnate!
choice_data_list: Next time, I'm going to beat Nishino Flower by a huge margin!
Next time, I'm going to beat Nishino Flower by a huge margin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does this mean I still
can't advance past short distances!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh~~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see!
So you win, and then you move on ahead!
choice_data_list: Our next target is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!
Our next target is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.text:
It's a GⅠ race at the same 1200m distance.
If she's walking the path of a sprinter, Nishino Flower
will almost certainly enter as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Understood!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaargh!!
Somehow I'm getting all fired uuup-pp-pp-pp!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, I found it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Bakushin O-san.
I'm here to say hello--

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flower-san!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My neck?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Fired?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wash your neck and wait for me!
Because next time, I'm absolutely, positively NOT gonna lose!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-Wash...? Huh?

And so, the next target race was decided
to be the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!
